data_source.name: SMARD day-ahead wholesale prices, DE/LU
data_source.terms_checked: 2026-11-22: CC BY 4.0 with this attribution; the page also states that the licensing of wholesale prices is under review (HEDWIG procedure), so only derived binary events and probabilities are shipped

event: mean of the three hourly day-ahead prices 17:00-20:00 Europe/Berlin on the target day is above that question's published price threshold
name: forecast-audit German electricity example
scope: 46 DE_LU evening-price questions, batch days 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-15; 29 YES, 17 NO
transformations: group_day = target (delivery) day; lock_at = the question's lock time
base_rate = the leak-free base rate stored with the golden question
fine_tuned_gguf = Platt(stored GGUF margin), clipped to [0.01, 0.99]
issued_at = the question's as-of time (a replay stamp, not a live time)
no hourly prices are shipped; only binary outcomes and probabilities
